name: BloomAPI
short_description: Healthcare data API service providing NPI lookup and provider information for care coordination and referral management applications.
long_description: BloomAPI is a healthcare data API service that provides streamlined access to NPI (National Provider Identifier) data and healthcare provider information. The API makes it easy to look up clinician identifiers, names, addresses, and credentials - information that serves as the foundation for referral management, care coordination, and provider directory applications. BloomAPI supports SSL connections and is designed to make healthcare technology accessible by connecting patients, providers, and payers through interoperable data access. The service is used by developers building mobile physician applications, referral platforms, and care coordination tools.
one_liner: Healthcare data API for NPI lookup and provider information access.
best_for: Healthcare technology developers building referral or directory features
Organizations needing programmatic access to NPI and provider data
Care coordination platforms requiring provider verification
EHR integrations needing real-time provider lookup
not_for: End-user clinicians seeking practice management software
Practices needing full care coordination workflow tools

pricing.notes: API access with usage-based pricing. Free tier available for development and low-volume use cases.

compliance.notes: Bloom Record Release is 100% HITECH and HIPAA compliant with federal standards. API provides access to public NPI data.
